name: Water & Sanitation
tagline: Reliable drinking water and safe sanitation for every settlement.
description: We work with village water committees to map, restore and maintain local sources — borewells, step wells and rainwater harvesting — and pair the hardware with hygiene training so systems keep working long after handover.

name: Community Health
tagline: Frontline care delivered by trained community volunteers.
description: Health camps, maternal nutrition support and a cadre of trained community health workers keep routine care within walking distance for settlements that have no clinic of their own.

name: Sustainable Livelihoods
tagline: Income that does not borrow against the future.
description: Farmer producer groups, kitchen-garden collectives and skill training give households a second income line while keeping soil, water and local markets in balance.

name: Education Access
tagline: Keeping children in school and learning well.
description: Remedial learning centres, scholarships and library corners work with government schools to close the gap between enrolment and actual learning outcomes.

name: Housing & Shelter
tagline: Safe, weatherproof homes built with the community.
description: Incremental, owner-driven housing upgrades with technical support, shared labour and a transparent materials ledger in every settlement.

name: Climate Resilience
tagline: Preparing communities for a less predictable climate.
description: Watershed treatment, cyclone preparedness drills and early-warning networks reduce the damage that extreme weather does to households already living close to the line.
